# Privacy deny-list: patterns that must never appear in this repository.
#
# This repository is public: it ships a product, never its owner's data.
# CI (.github/workflows/privacy.yml) fails on a match, in the working tree
# and in the whole history; run ./scripts/privacy-scan.sh locally too.
#
# This file is itself public, so it holds PATTERNS (identifier shapes), not
# secrets. The owner's own vocabulary (names, hostnames, serial numbers)
# goes in .github/privacy-denylist.local.txt, gitignored, which CI gets from
# the PRIVACY_DENYLIST_LOCAL repository secret.
#
# Format: one extended regex per line, matched case-insensitively. Blank
# lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Paths in .privacyignore are
# not scanned.

# --- Personal identifiers ----------------------------------------------------
# Emails at the big providers (tests use example.com, which is reserved).
[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@(gmail|googlemail|outlook|hotmail|live|yahoo|icloud|me|proton|protonmail)\.[a-z]{2,}
# Phone numbers in international form.
\+[0-9]{2}\s?[0-9]{9,}

# --- Real data from a source ------------------------------------------------
# Audiobookshelf ids are UUIDs: one in the code or the tests was copied from
# a real server. Fixtures use readable ids ("book-dune", "s1").
[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}
# API keys and tokens in the shapes Audiobookshelf issues (JWT).
eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}

# --- Infrastructure details --------------------------------------------------
# Private addresses (tests use the documentation range 203.0.113.0/24).
\b(10|192\.168)\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\b
\b172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\b
# Internal hostnames, in host position only (a bare "\.local\b" also
# matches file names like privacy-denylist.local.txt).
(https?://|@|[[:space:]])[a-z0-9-]+\.(local|lan|internal|home\.arpa)([:/[:space:]]|$)
# Kubernetes in-cluster service names of a real deployment.
\.svc\.cluster\.local
# Secret-store paths.
(vault|secret)/(data|kv|apps)/
kubeconfig
